CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3857 OF 2003
WITH 
Civil Appeal NO. 3858 of 2003; Civil Appeal NO. 3859 of 2003 
SLP(C) NO. 23467 of 2004; SLP(C) NO. 23468 of 2004
        During the pendency of these appeals, a similar question has been considered by the 
Constitution Bench of this Court in M. Nagaraj & Ors. Vs. Union of India & Ors. 
(2006) 8 SCC 212.  In view of the conclusion arrived at by the Constitution Bench in 
paragraphs 121 and 122 of M. Nagaraj case (supra), these appeals have become 
infructous and are, accordingly, dismissed as infructuous.
